title: Olea feasibility experiment — interim evidence
expectedMission: Kotlin Android host supervises minimal Ubuntu Base/PRoot, one shared stock Node backend and persistent unmodified Pi RPC subprocesses. Required evidence includes real Unix/dependency/child work, three Pi releases, ordinary upgrade, permission-controlled Accessibility launcher click and all phone categories, independently asserted model workflows, lifecycle recovery and measured total resource cost.
actualMission: Disposable Kotlin/runtime and shared-backend source exists in peer worktrees; this report is an interim snapshot pending Android integration. Verified bootstrap artifacts and host-only agent/backend results establish preparation and interface feasibility on Windows, not the intended on-phone mission. Android Unix execution, phone actions, lifecycle and resource measurements have not been assessed in this snapshot.
rationale: No complete Android-hosted Unix plus phone workflow or ordinary Android upstream upgrade has been independently established in the evidence supplied so far. Host successes and downloaded artifacts cannot substitute for these outcomes.

Earlier Pi0.74.0 and1.0.0, same-base three-version comparison, ordinary upstream upgrade to1.5.2 and update preservation remain unassessed in this snapshot. No release-specific shim or private patch is an accepted substitute.

Claude Agent SDK query import and native stock Codex/Claude startup on Android require actual runtime evidence. Installation/startup/help, supported interface availability and authenticated tool workflows are separate assertions.
blockers: Android integration pending; no assessed on-phone Unix/phone case in this interim report.
Agent-specific Codex/Claude authentication/subscription not supplied for this experiment. Authorized Pi custom provider credentials do not authenticate these agents.
Physical Android14 phone not connected and ABI unestablished; ARM64, device-specific lifecycle, battery and thermals blocked.

Ordinary user permission/consent paths, Accessibility launcher click, direct category fixtures, agent discovery/use, revocation and stop require independent native observations. Development ADB provisioning is not normal-use evidence.
Hidden fixture oracle must remain outside agent workspace/tools; conversations and model claims alone are insufficient. Uncertain phone actions must not replay after lifecycle death.
Host/provider/network failure is distinct from Android runtime failure. Unexecuted cases remain untested; pending prerequisites do not establish a runtime defect.
nextDecision: Continue bounded Android integration and independently verify Unix plus Accessibility launcher-click outcomes before judging the selected stack. Measure total process cost and ordinary upgrades, inspect stock Codex/Claude runtime blockers and obtain a connected physical phone before ARM64 claims. Keep production architecture and UX acceptance open.
